If I find extra alpha, I might feed the geese. Been a while since I posted anything good.

tweets.text:
$ENA One of those coins that is very sensitive to momentum.

During up trends, it tends to outperform. During down trends, it underperforms. Very momentum heavy coin.

With that said, I initially caught a nice spot bag move on this. I bought somewhere around ~$0.085 in the summer and sold it slightly early in that circle around $0.22. Good trade nonetheless.

Since then I been patiently waiting for a sizeable correction to get back in this. I think we are now at that zone where this gets interesting to me again. Below $0.14, which was the previous range high, I have no interest in touching it anymore. But between $0.14-$0.16 I do see this as a solid value zone for ENA as a longer term spot bag. Wicks below into the Daily 200MA would still be ok, but I want to see the daily closes maintain above the $0.14 level.

I will say that it is perfectly fine to wait to buy these kind of coins after the momentum turns, instead of knife catching. You would miss some initial of the move but have a smaller chance of getting caught as the down trend continues. Could even wait for some low timeframe market structure flip to bullish again before considering any buys at all. That is usually when I buy into new spot bags.

Fact is, the market as it is now is still very sketchy, BTC at a big support and we just had a massive down day. So for me the plan is to just start slowly scaling in and try to get as low a cost basis as possible. Then sit it out for another 3-6 months as hopefully the market creates a higher low and rallies from there.

On perps I would not easily be able to do this personally as the swings you'd have to endure in between are pretty tough and it is easy to get wicked out on your stop loss for example.

Just sharing some thoughts. Keep an eye on this region.

tweets.text:
There's the relief bounce.

$BTC and crypto lagging behind for now.

Big question will be of course, did the likes of $NVDA etc set a bottom here on the back of all the forced selling and liquidations? Or is it just a short covering bounce.

I do believe as my friend @0xmock also mentioned that people underestimate how well these big tech corporations can handle different macro/political environments.

We also know politicians generally underdeliver massively on their promises once they are elected.

So all the fear that is in the market now with the "Anti AI/Datacenter" narrative is likely at least somewhat inflated.

quote.text:
I've not been a fan of the bottleneck AI companies as they were already clearly seeing capital rotating from them into the rest of the market since the Summer.

But this is a crazy sell off, even in the new political picture we're in now.

Not sure where these bottom out but NVDA is now trading at a 13x forward P/E (or 19 for 2027) which is crazy low even if you think the datacenter build out slows down drastically. Obviously you could get some P/E compression if these the earnings really slow down but still, a lot of froth was already taken out of them.

Anyways, my long term stock holdings are mostly in ETFs with some individual names on the side like $AMZN, $META etc. These are multi year holds so nothing changes there.

But I will be closely looking at how this (primarily) AI bottleneck company sell off continues and might start shopping at some point.

Many of these were hot & overextended this year, yes. But still very bullish AI in general for the next decade ahead. So if you get some fire sale discounts it's always good to watch closely.

NFA, just sharing my thoughts on the market.

$ETH Currently caught in between some big levels.

Right on the big .618 Fibonacci retracement level and the Daily 200MA.

But the Daily 200EMA and $2350 horizontal area have been causing trouble.

You'd want to see a move back above $2350 for a proper sign of strength that the bullish momentum is back. Below, that ~$2150 level is key otherwise this just keeps bleeding lower and starts giving back a lot of that breakout candle.

Would recommend to play this level by level to not get chopped up in the middle.

Fire sale being bought up today. Likely lots of short covering too.

Going to be an interesting trading day today into the weekend.

quote.text:
I've not been a fan of the bottleneck AI companies as they were already clearly seeing capital rotating from them into the rest of the market since the Summer.

But this is a crazy sell off, even in the new political picture we're in now.

Not sure where these bottom out but NVDA is now trading at a 13x forward P/E (or 19 for 2027) which is crazy low even if you think the datacenter build out slows down drastically. Obviously you could get some P/E compression if these the earnings really slow down but still, a lot of froth was already taken out of them.

Anyways, my long term stock holdings are mostly in ETFs with some individual names on the side like $AMZN, $META etc. These are multi year holds so nothing changes there.

But I will be closely looking at how this (primarily) AI bottleneck company sell off continues and might start shopping at some point.

Many of these were hot & overextended this year, yes. But still very bullish AI in general for the next decade ahead. So if you get some fire sale discounts it's always good to watch closely.

NFA, just sharing my thoughts on the market.

quote.text:
I think all of this stuff is actually very simple tbh. 

You act as a billboard for these coins by retweeting, interacting or hosting spaces etc with the celebrity. Then the coins rug and the celeb or Sahil or whoever makes money. 

Their plan is obvious: make the coin go up by getting attention to it via you (as you have written and acknowledged, attention is very valuable). Your followers will gamble on stuff that you have mentioned in a hope you’ll mention it again, or that they’ll hit an Iggy-style multiple. And that injection of $ makes it possible for celeb to make 100k or whatever and leave. 

And, you have been a proponent of select celebrity coins, which endorses a “meta” even without direct endorsement of some coins — since there is no explainable framework where Iggy’s coin is good but Soulja Boy’s is bad. The only difference is how long they are waiting to sell. 

The answer for you is simple: completely stop interacting with these people in public until you have evidence of good faith — which is likely them taking significant financial risk (eg buying a lot of something) rather than taking zero financial risk (eg only selling something). 

If you have a large account and a bunch of followers that ape a lot of stuff, unfortunately extractive actors will try to groom you or use you for their own personal gain. 

It sucks actually, and it’s almost impossible to entirely defend against without becoming a jaded recluse. But celebrities are at least very easy to avoid.

If they want to “get into crypto” then they should put $ where their mouth is and buy coins like the rest of us do. That’s what being in crypto is. If they don’t want to do that, ask yourself, why would these celebrities want to suddenly be your friend?
